full_judgment: 16. On the contrary, the plaintiff's oral evidence are not supported by any documen-tary evidence, like Khatian or Khajna Dakhila and he has utterly failed to discharge the burden of proof that rested on him. Besides, as has been rightly pointed out by the trial court, and concurred with by the appellate court, the plaintiff has falsely claimed that he was in possession of the suit property. It was found by both the courts bellow that, the plaintiff's suit was liable to be dismissed under the provisions of section 42 of the Specific Relief Act, 1877, for not seeking consequential relief by way of recovery of khas possession, which is, in my considered opinion, is correct opinion of the courts below.
